bead.title: Restore root Go verification baseline
bead.description: Context: the async hybrid spec bead pqueue-27e864ea is blocked by its Go verification AC because root go test ./... fails before touching Go code. The failing tests in go_root_test.go still expect a removed crates/pqueue-kafka/tests/compat/producer_oracle module and the older deployment backend matrix/proof vocabulary (postgres_native/object_log_sqlite_projection, --backend, backend_profiles/backend_profile_matrix). Current .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/ci/deployment-release-gate.sh use one storage combination, objectlog:inmemory, expressed as --log-backend objectlog --projection-backend inmemory and proof fields storage_combinations/release_notes.storage_matrix. Update only the stale root Go tests/helpers so they validate current scripts instead of obsolete names. Do not weaken release/deployment script behavior; if producer_oracle is absent, treat that optional compatibility module as a skipped subtest with an exact skip message. In-scope files: go_root_test.go. Out-of-scope: changing CI workflow behavior, changing deployment-release-gate behavior, changing Rust code, changing hybrid async docs.
